notes.title: DoE on Sale and ReignMaker 2 Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zm4O7C9.png[/img]

[h1][b]The story of Dungeon of Elements continues in ReignMaker 2 which has launched on Kickstarter![/b][/h1]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/frogdice/reignmaker-2-not-your-fathers-match-3

Put your reflexes, cleverness, pattern recognition, and strategy to the test. Action-packed match 3 with a side of world domination.

ReignMaker 2 is a match 3, tower defense, city building, and strategy game. And once you feel you have mastered the game, you can go online to form clans and compete against others individually or as clans to see who is truly the Master of the Elements.

[h1]ALSO: Dungeon of Elements *AND* ReignMaker 1 are on sale this week![/h1]

If you enjoyed any of these games, get the others for the full story of the Void invasion of the world of Primordiax!

[b]TIMELINE[/b]: Dungeon of Elements -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/286200/ReignMaker/]ReignMaker 1[/url] -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466660/Stash/]Stash[/url] -> ReignMaker 2

[u][h1]ReignMaker 2[/h1][/u]
New story, new towers, new spells, new monsters with new AI, new gear, new match combo types, new achievement, and more!

Thank you so much for playing our games and for your support.

Please back ReignMaker 2 on kickstarter to help us make it the best game possible.

Thanks!

notes.title: Stash, our MMO that continues the storyline, has launched!
notes.notes:
[h1]Continue the storyline of Dungeon of Elements in our new mmo, Stash![/h1]

The Void Threat has not been vanquished!

Now you can face them head on as a hero and adventurer.

[b]We are bringing the magic back to MMOs with turn based combat, an incredible community, and unique gameplay.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/466660/Stash/

See you in game!
